description: Biodiversity by Place. How well is life recorded here? One API for any point on Earth, built from the GBIF occurrence snapshot of 1 October 2026 and counted on a fixed 0.5 degree grid (about 55 km). Routes: /gaps (level, country, admin1, max_records, stale, min_cells, limit, offset); /cells (country, admin1, lat, lon, min_records, max_records, sort, limit, offset); /place (lat*, lon*, top, species); /admin1 (country*, by, limit, offset); /nearby (lat*, lon*, radius_cells, limit, offset); /decades (country); /summary; /countries (by, continent, min_cells, limit, offset); /admin1/{code}; /cells/{cell_id} (scheme); /countries/{iso2}. Paid $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /gaps, /cells, /place, /admin1, /nearby, /decades, /summary, /countries, /admin1/{code}, /cells/{cell_id}, /countries/{iso2}. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.

name: biodiversity
